before.alt: Weighted undirected graph on 9 vertices with edge weights 1 and 2. Left cluster of six vertices: top-left a, top-right b, left c, centre d, right e, bottom f. Edges: a-b 2, a-c 2, a-d 1, b-d 2, b-e 1, c-d 2, d-e 2, c-f 1, d-f 1. Bottom edge f-h weight 2 to the right triangle g,h,i with edges g-h 2, g-i 1, h-i 2.

after.alt: Weighted undirected graph on 9 unlabelled vertices with edge weights 1 and 2. Left: a hexagonal cluster of six vertices (top-left, top-right, left, centre, right, bottom) — top-left to top-right 2, top-left to left 2, top-left to centre 1, top-right to centre 2, top-right to right 1, left to centre 2, centre to right 2, left to bottom 1, centre to bottom 1. A long edge of weight 2 joins the bottom vertex to the bottom-left vertex of a triangle on the right, whose sides are bottom-left to top 2, top to bottom-right 1 and bottom-left to bottom-right 2.
